name: ce.breakpoints
description: Manage generation-bound Windows or VEH hardware debug-register breakpoints. Per-breakpoint callback 1 waits; global callback 0 is valid. Hits are history, not current stop context: use fresh status and stopGeneration. Remove releases the logical handle and requests native disable by CE breakpoint ID, never by a shared address. Native list deletion may be deferred; do not repeat removal based on native list presence. Remove only owned breakpoints, then release debugger control.

action.description: Remove only an owned logical handle and request native disable by CE breakpoint ID, never by address. Native list deletion may be deferred; do not repeat removal merely because the native list still contains the address.
